blocks.text: A brief word on the reporter conversations Michelle mentioned, since your colleagues may ask about them. They are held on background only; we neither speak for {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} nor characterize its plans, and what we hear will reach you as themes in summary form rather than as notes of individual calls.

If there is any outlet you would prefer we not approach, a note to Michelle is enough, and we will set it aside. I will send you a short summary of the early themes once the leadership round is complete.
